title: FATCAT: Fault Injection Attacks Targeting Chip-level Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.31129v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Model alignment is the primary safety and security mechanism for enforcing refusal of malicious prompts in modern foundation models; yet, existing adversarial evaluations implicitly assume underlying hardware integrity. In this paper, we present FATCAT, the first physical fault-injection attacks capable of eliminating refusal in modern large language and vision-language models. Specifically, we present a non-invasive electromagnetic (EM) fault injection attack targeting GPU-accelerated Systems-on-Chip with physical access, requiring neither software execution privileges nor model-layer access. By leveraging an autonomous Radio Frequency (RF) side-channel trigger to synchronize EM faults to the prompt prefill phase, the attack corrupts safety-critical memory transactions across off-chip LPDDR5 DRAM and on-chip LPDDR physical interfaces without crashing the system while preserving model coherence. Evaluated on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano

translated_title: FATCAT：针对芯片级对齐的故障注入攻击
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.31129v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：模型对齐是现代基础模型中强制拒答恶意提示的首要安全与防护机制；然而，现有的对抗性评估都隐式地假设底层硬件是完整可信的。在本文中，我们提出了FATCAT，这是首个能够消除现代大型语言模型和视觉语言模型拒答行为的物理故障注入攻击。具体而言，我们提出了一种针对可物理接触的GPU加速片上系统的非侵入式电磁故障注入攻击，该攻击既不需要软件执行权限，也不需要模型层访问。通过利用自主的射频（RF）侧信道触发器将电磁故障同步到提示预填充阶段，该攻击在不导致系统崩溃的同时，破坏片外LPDDR5 DRAM以及片上LPDDR物理接口上的安全关键内存事务，并保持模型的连贯性。该攻击在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上进行了评估（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出首个针对大语言模型对齐机制的物理电磁故障注入攻击FATCAT，无需软件权限或模型层访问，即可在保持模型连贯性的同时消除模型对恶意提示的拒答能力。
en_tdlr: FATCAT is the first physical EM fault-injection attack that eliminates refusal in LLMs and VLMs by corrupting safety-critical memory transactions, requiring no software privileges or model-layer access while preserving model coherence.
